title.purpose: Sub-sections, dialog titles, gauge values (gauges may go to 1.7rem/700).

micro-label.purpose: Table headers, gauge captions, eyebrows, status tags. The stencil voice - use it for labels-of-data, never for prose.

identifier.purpose: PO/request numbers, product codes, opening/leaf refs, bins, packing slips. Never for prose.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: The only ambient shadow: cards and gauges on hover, paired with a one-step border darken and an optional 1px lift, 0.2s. Depth is feedback, never decoration.

shadows.name: amber-edge
shadows.purpose: The Amber-Edge Rule's mechanism: selection and current state as a 3px inset left edge on rows, nav items, gauges, and wizard steps. Dark scheme uses #ffd54f. Never a full amber fill on a content surface.

motion.name: spring-fast
motion.purpose: Chips, tags, toggles, small state flips.

motion.name: spring-base
motion.purpose: Cards, rows, panels, dialogs, page entrances. The default.

motion.name: spring-slow
motion.purpose: Large surfaces: master-detail rail collapse, panel resize.

motion.name: counter-spring
motion.purpose: Numeric counters on gauges: values count up on mount and on change.

motion.name: stagger
motion.purpose: Card grids and gauge rows enter in sequence; the dashboard may orchestrate greeting to gauges to feed within 0.6s.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover shadow, border-color, and background changes on resting surfaces.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion collapses to opacity or nothing
motion.purpose: Enforced globally via MotionConfig and a CSS media query. Not optional.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The screen's one primary action (e.g. Create PO). Amber fill, ink text, 3px edge.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>Create PO</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffca28; color: #1d1b17; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; padding: 6px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffb300; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1b17; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #d19700; }

components.name: Structural (Ink) Button
components.description: Structural or confirm actions. Ink fill, paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #1d1b17; color: #fdfcfa; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; padding: 6px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3a362f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1b17; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Lower-priority and inline row actions. Ink hairline and text on transparent.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #1d1b17; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; padding: 6px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(29,27,23,0.28); border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out, border-color 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(29,27,23,0.05); border-color: #1d1b17; } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1b17; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Square stenciled status marker. Tinted ground at 12% of the status hue, 1px border at 55%, text in the status hue. Status meaning never comes from the accent.
components.html: Staged Pending Cancelled
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid; } .ds-tag-success { background: rgba(46,125,50,0.12); border-color: rgba(46,125,50,0.55); color: #2e7d32; } .ds-tag-warning { background: rgba(237,108,2,0.12); border-color: rgba(237,108,2,0.55); color: #ed6c02; } .ds-tag-error { background: rgba(211,47,47,0.12); border-color: rgba(211,47,47,0.55); color: #d32f2f; }

components.name: Stat Gauge
components.description: Compact dashboard gauge: tabular value, micro-label caption, optional 3px amber edge for 'needs someone now'. Flat, hairline-bordered, flex 1 1 0. Never a gradient hero-metric.
components.css: .ds-gauge { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 130px; background: #fdfcfa; border: 1px solid rgba(29,27,23,0.14); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease-in-out, border-color 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-gauge-attention { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #ffca28; } .ds-gauge:hover { border-color: rgba(29,27,23,0.28); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #ffca28, 0 4px 14px rgba(29,27,23,0.09); } .ds-gauge-value { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; color: #1d1b17; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-gauge-caption { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c564b; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: MUI outlined small field. Hairline stroke, 4px radius, real floating label (a placeholder-only label is a bug).
components.css: .ds-field { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c564b; } .ds-field-input { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #1d1b17; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(29,27,23,0.28); border-radius: 4px; background: #fdfcfa; transition: border-color 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: #1d1b17; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #1d1b17; border-width: 2px; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.name: The Ledger
components.description: Signature component. Transparent header over a 2px ink rule, micro-label header type, hairline row dividers, mono identifier columns, right-aligned tabular counts, amber-edge selection. No tinted header fill.
components.css: .ds-ledger { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #1d1b17; background: #fdfcfa; } .ds-ledger th { background: transparent; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; color: #5c564b; text-align: left; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d1b17; } .ds-ledger td { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(29,27,23,0.14); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger tbody tr { cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-ledger tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(29,27,23,0.04); } .ds-ledger-selected { background: rgba(29,27,23,0.06); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #ffca28; } .ds-ledger-id { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-ledger-num { text-align: right; }

components.name: Nav Rail Item
components.description: Persistent desktop rail entry. Stroke icon (Lucide), never a filled Material glyph; the active module carries the 3px amber edge.
components.html: Purchase OrdersWarehouse
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fdfcfa; border-right: 1px solid rgba(29,27,23,0.14); padding: 8px 0; min-width: 200px; } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5c564b; text-decoration: none; padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 4px; transition: background 0.2s ease-in-out, color 0.2s ease-in-out; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(29,27,23,0.04); color: #1d1b17; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1b17; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rail-active { color: #1d1b17; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(29,27,23,0.06); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #ffca28; }

narrative.overview:
UC Nexus is one continuous lifecycle - TITAN import, purchase orders, warehouse receiving, shop assembly, shipping - and every module draws from a single MUI theme: one warm-neutral palette, two typographic voices, one 3px-edge accent motif, one component set. The visual language never changes station to station. What changes is density and rhythm, and only that.

The character is industrial and precise - a dependable shop tool. The neutrals are *warm* steel and kraft (never the stock Material grey ramp): ink `#1d1b17`, bone canvas, warm-white paper, and a night-shift warm charcoal in dark mode. Structure is carried by hairline borders and 2px ink rules, not shadows or tinted fills. A single Shop Amber accent marks the one thing that matters on a screen and doubles as the selection *edge*. Data speaks in its own voice: identifiers in a mono face, counts in tabular numerals, captions as stenciled micro-labels. Iconography is stroke-based (Lucide), never filled Material glyphs.

Density flexes by station, within the one language:

- Dashboard (home): compact bordered gauges and a bounded activity feed, scannable in one glance.
- Operational tables (PO, warehouse): the ledger is the screen - 2px header rule, mono identifiers, right-aligned tabular counts, inline filters, status tags, row hover with a clear affordance.
- Guided wizard (import / Start a Task): linear and calm; one decision per step; step content transitions quickly.
- Master-detail (shop assembly, shipping, locations): compact list rail plus a wide detail pane; the rail collapse is animated so the space handoff reads as physical.
- Task modals: focused overlays; titled, section-ruled, actions bottom-right, destructive actions in the error hue.

This system explicitly rejects consumer SaaS gloss, sprawl (regions that don't earn their space), legacy-ERP gray-on-gray, and decorative motion. If a screen looks like a template, it is wrong.
keyCharacteristics: One shared theme across every module; density varies, vocabulary does not.
Warm steel/kraft neutrals + a single Shop Amber accent spent as edge + primary action.
Flat and bordered at rest; elevation only as feedback (hover, dialogs).
Two type voices: Source Sans 3 for UI, IBM Plex Mono for identifiers; hierarchy from weight/size.
Every region earns its space; the viewport never scrolls sideways.
Full light and dark schemes, WCAG 2.1 AA, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Shop Amber marks at most one primary thing per screen, plus the selection edge. If two amber fills compete, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Amber-Edge Rule
rules.body: Selection and "current" are expressed as a 3px amber left edge (rows, nav items, gauges, steps) - never as a full amber fill on content surfaces.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Status hues mean real system state, exclusively.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure Material greys (`#f5f5f5`, `#eeeeee`, `#9e9e9e`...). Every neutral comes from the warm ramp above.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 for UI, Plex Mono for identifiers - no third family, no display face. Anything that names a *thing in the system* (a PO, a code, a bin) is mono; anything that talks to the user is sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any column of figures gets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` and right alignment.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: A resting shadow is a bug.

dos: Do keep one vocabulary across modules; the same action looks the same everywhere.
Do spend amber on one primary thing per screen plus the selection edge.
Do put every identifier in mono and every figure column in tabular numerals.
Do size regions to content; let one flexible element absorb slack.
Do ship every interactive state, use skeletons over spinners, animate entrances once.
Do reserve status hues for real state and render them as tags.
donts: Don't reintroduce Material greys, filled icons, pill chips, or tinted table-header fills.
Don't sprawl - no lone full-width cards, no 2-character values in 250px columns, no stranded far-edge timestamps.
Don't let motion decorate: no gradients, no bounce, no load choreography beyond the one entrance, nothing above ~0.6s.
Don't let the viewport scroll sideways (`min-width: 0` on flex/grid children).
Don't reach for a modal first; and never let Escape silently discard typed input.
Don't render raw enums, machine strings, or unpluralized counts to a human.
